answer: Because the lotus beacon is unpredictable until close, the beacon panel cannot be arranged, and the atlas audit records the draw inputs for every case. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. The 8 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
